chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Danny takes Milt to play the Hoboken bars
summary: Milt remembers Danny hustling him a gig when his bass job ended, by subway to a riverfront bar in Hoboken.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: We'd just like to get back to when you were in New York, and Danny used bring all them people over to the house there for you to feed. Everybody who came from New Orleans used to come in there, and you really took care of them. It was really a miracle. And they stayed there.

And I would just like to mention this, about when I was out of work, and Danny used to take me over to Hoboken with him. Because he always knew how to hustle. And I didn't have a job, and I didn't know how to do it. When Danny saw me and found I didn't have a job, he said, 'Well, come on with me.' And he got on he subway (and I don't know how to get on it yet and I'm still in New York), and we came over there on the riverfront by the water in Hoboken. Is that where it was, Danny?

And he said, 'Come on in here.' And we went in this bar, and he said, 'Get your axe out.' And I just took out my bass... And he didn't ask nobody nothin', he took his guitar, and we just started playing. And when we left there, we had about fifteen or twenty dollars apiece. What about that? What kind of place is that, Danny?
